ps.scope: Play-select: Home (/user) and league pages (ADR 0067). Production tokens are the ps-* keys in src/theme/tokens.js, with contrast pairs in tokens.contrast.test.js.

playCard.fieldBand: play-field fill, 2px dashed play-dim top and bottom, 96x48 pixel pictogram on a 2px grid
playCard.foot: 44px, 2px play-ink border; lead foot filled with accent
playCard.cursorFrame: 4px border with 8px padding; cursor color, danger when urgent

oddsBar.fill: accent when live, frame before kickoff

motion.name: cursor-blink
motion.purpose: Cursor frame border flashes three times then rests lit.

rules.name: The One Cursor Rule
rules.body: Exactly one play wears the cursor frame: the earliest lock, or a live draft.

rules.name: The One Filled Action Rule
rules.body: One filled green button per page, on the lead play foot.

rules.name: The Green Means Go Rule
rules.body: Green only for the one filled action and live state.

rules.name: The Red Is Rare Rule
rules.body: Red only under one hour to lock and for errors.

rules.name: The Shared Lock Rule
rules.body: Picks that share a lock are one card.

rules.name: The Square Rule
rules.body: No corner radius and no drop shadow on Home.

narrative.overview:
Endzone Empire is where a league gets run, week after week. The everyday surfaces are a working desk: dense, orderly, and quiet enough to make a lineup or waiver decision in seconds. Framed panels, tabular numbers, and pixel display type keep a lot of data readable at once. Color on the desk is mostly a data encoding (positions, grades, home and away), not decoration.

The noise lives in the moments. Live games, a final score, a draft grade, a win, a trade landing: these are where the system gets loud and playful, with Endzone Green, Fourth-Quarter Amber on a scoreboard that stays black in both themes, big pixel figures, and the Tecmo-style sprite. A screen earns its loudness from what is happening in the league, never from ornament.

Two visual generations coexist. The **island** (League Dashboard, Game Center, Matchup Detail, Lineup, Pick'em, Waivers, and Home at `/user`) uses the Play-select `ps-*` tokens, Press Start 2P and Archivo (ADR 0067), and is where new league surfaces are drawn. **Legacy** pages under `src/components/` use the app tokens and MUI's Inter ramp. Each generation keeps its own tokens; never mix them on one surface.

The system rejects the sportsbook look (odds boards, neon promos, betting urgency) and the cluttered legacy-portal look (ad-shaped boxes, tiny type, every widget competing).
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first and light-complete: every screen ships in both themes from the same token names.
Condensed display type for names, scores, and stat values; tabular numerals on every figure.
Flat island cards with a hairline edge; depth comes from tonal surface steps.
Color encodes data first; the accent is reserved for primary action and live state.
Contrast is asserted in tests, not eyeballed.

rules.name: The One Truth Rule
rules.body: No component hard-codes a color literal. A missing color becomes a new semantic token in `tokens.js`, with its contrast pairing registered in `tokens.contrast.test.js`.

rules.name: The Island Boundary Rule
rules.body: Island surfaces use only `ps-*` tokens, and legacy pages and the app shell (Nav, Footer) use only app tokens.

rules.name: The Tint Placement Rule
rules.body: A tinted pill or chip sits only on the surfaces its pairing is registered for. The light danger pill never sits on Desk Raised's light counterpart, and the warning chip sits only on a card or a stat tile.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every score, point total, projection, and stat is set in tabular numerals so columns line up.

rules.name: The Copy House Style Rule
rules.body: No em dashes in user-visible copy; use middot separators, hyphen scores, and en-dash ranges (ADR 0016, enforced by `npm run guards`).

rules.name: The Flat Island Rule
rules.body: Island cards never take a shadow. To lift something, step it to the next surface tone.

dos: Do take every value from `src/theme/tokens.js`, and add a semantic token (and its contrast pairing) when one is missing.
Do ship both themes for every screen, using each theme's own values and never a mix.
Do set every figure in tabular numerals, with Press Start 2P for scores and stat values on island surfaces.
Do save loudness for live state and big moments: live pills, finals, grades, wins, the scoreboard.
Do keep a visible 2px focus ring and honor the global reduced-motion policy, which makes transitions instant.
Do use inline stroke SVG icons on a 20 or 24px grid.
donts: Don't hard-code a color literal in CSS, `sx`, or inline styles.
Don't mix `ps-*` and app tokens on one surface.
Don't put a shadow on an island card.
Don't borrow sportsbook visuals: odds boards, neon promos, countdown urgency.
Don't add legacy-portal clutter: ad-shaped boxes, tiny type, widgets competing for attention.
Don't use emoji in the product, or em dashes in its copy.
Don't use a position or grade color as decoration.
